script_text: Stop! Pisces, the stars are screaming at you right now. Neptune, your ruling planet of water and dreams, is sextiling Pluto in your 11th House of alliances while Venus opposes Saturn in your 2nd House of money. In love, if single you attract a soulful healer through artistic circles; if taken, avoid cold budget talks that trigger distance. Career-wise, a 6th House trine from Mercury to Jupiter brings paid detail work—invoice by noon. Warning: do not lend cash to a sibling under this Saturn pressure. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
